service.description: The name of the service these settings apply to.
service.security_impact: Identifies which service is being restricted. Misconfigured service targeting can leave critical apps exposed.
service.rationale: Ensures ingress rules are properly applied to sensitive services.

network_settings.description: Ingress settings for this service. Will apply to all versions.
network_settings.security_impact: Defines which sources can reach the App Engine service. Incorrect ingress settings can expose apps to the public internet unnecessarily.
network_settings.rationale: Restrict ingress traffic to internal or load-balanced requests to minimize exposure.

ingress_traffic_allowed.description: The ingress settings for version or service. Default value is `INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_UNSPECIFIED`. Possible values are: `INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_UNSPECIFIED`, `INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_ALL`, `INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_ONLY`, `INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_AND_LB`.
ingress_traffic_allowed.security_impact: Controls whether external/public traffic is allowed. Allowing all traffic creates unnecessary risk.
ingress_traffic_allowed.rationale: Ingress should be restricted to internal or load balancer traffic for production systems.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.security_impact: Ensures network restrictions are tied to the correct project context. Mis-targeting may leave services unprotected.
project.rationale: Explicitly define the project to avoid accidental inheritance or misapplication of rules.
project.non-compliant: Relying on implicit provider project without validation.
